hero.headline: Supplying the World with the Finest Almonds
hero.body: We specialize in premium wholesale almonds sourced directly from trusted farms. With unmatched freshness, rich taste, and global supply capabilities, we ensure your business receives only the best—straight from the orchards to your doorstep

sections.heading: Farm Fresh Almond
sections.body: Sourced from the finest farms, our almonds are carefully handpicked to ensure premium quality. Rich in protein, fiber, and essential nutrients, they make the perfect choice for a healthy lifestyle. Each almond is naturally sun-dried, preserving its authentic taste and crunch. Packed fresh to seal in flavor and goodness for longer shelf life. Enjoy the perfect blend of health, taste, and energy in every bite.

testimonials.quote: We have been sourcing almonds from this company for over a year now, and the Orange Bag almonds are our best-sellers. The consistency in taste, crunch, and freshness is unmatched.
testimonials.author: Ramesh Patel

testimonials.quote: The Purple and Pink Bag almonds are absolutely loved by our health-conscious clients. The packaging is not just vibrant but also makes inventory management easier for us.
testimonials.author: Nidhi Sharma

intro: Deepak Mange & Co. is a well-established food processing and trading firm specializing in the import, processing, and distribution of premium edible nuts, with a strong focus on almonds. Since our incorporation in 2018, we have earned a reputation for sourcing the finest dry fruits, maintaining strict quality standards, and ensuring efficient distribution across India and beyond.

With our strategic presence in Navi Mumbai’s APMC Market, we have emerged as a trusted name in the dry fruit and agro-commodity sector. Our success is driven by our commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction.
expertise: Dry Fruit Import & Trade: Direct sourcing from international markets including the USA, Australia, and the Middle East.
Processing & Quality Control: Advanced sorting, grading, and hygienic packaging to deliver top-quality products.
Market Expansion: A strong domestic presence complemented by growing international trade relations.
Supply Chain Management: Efficient procurement, storage, and logistics for seamless distribution.

quality_commitment.heading: Quality Commitment
quality_commitment.intro: At Deepak Mange & Co., we place quality at the core of everything we do. Our processes are built on:
points: FSSAI Certification ensuring compliance with India’s food safety and hygiene standards.
Hygienic Processing Practices through sanitized units and hands-free technology.
Regular Quality Testing to guarantee that every product meets stringent industry benchmarks.

founder.heading: Leadership
founder.name: Deepak Arjan Mange
founder.title: Founder
founder.bio: Deepak Arjan Mange, the founder of Deepak Mange & Co., is a seasoned entrepreneur with deep expertise in the global dry fruit trade. His strong network of suppliers and distributors, combined with a vision for growth and sustainability, drives the company forward as a leading player in India’s dry fruit industry.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.intro: We are continuously working to expand and diversify our operations to meet evolving consumer needs. Our future goals include:
points: Expanding processing facilities with modern automation.
Launching value-added dry fruit products for the retail and wholesale markets.
Strengthening e-commerce and digital trade channels.
Investing in eco-friendly and sustainable processing practices.
